visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a woman's face against a plain white background, showing natural skin with visible dark circles and minor blemishes. At the bottom left, a man wearing a black T-shirt appears in a circular inset, speaking and gesturing with high energy. (2) The camera remains on the woman's face as the man continues to speak. Text overlays appear near her eyes and cheeks, highlighting areas of concern like dark circles and redness. The man uses his hands to emphasize his points. (3) A three-color makeup palette labeled 'KAIBEAUTY #02 Red Ruby' is shown being held by a hand. The person swatches two shades on their hand, mixing them. A small brush then applies the mixed concealer to the woman's under-eye area. (4) The woman's face is shown partially corrected as a second palette, '#03 Green Olive,' is introduced. Similar swatches are made on the hand. The brush applies a greenish-beige shade to the side of the woman's nose and cheeks to neutralize redness. (5) A third palette, '#01 Honey Peach,' is displayed. Swatches are demonstrated once more. The brush is used to apply a peach-toned product to the woman's nasolabial folds and bridge of the nose to brighten and 'plump' these areas. (6) The final shot shows the man full-screen against the white studio background. He is clapping and speaking enthusiastically to the audience, encouraging them to try these techniques to upgrade their makeup base.

The BGM remains steady with a driving synthesizer beat. (3) A subtle digital 'click' sound effect accompanies the visual transition of opening a makeup palette. The narrator's tone remains friendly and highly persuasive. (4) A crisp 'whoosh' transition SFX triggers a new instructional phase. The speaker's volume is projected and clear, maintaining high vocal arousal. (5) Another 'whoosh' SFX marks the final product introduction.
